summary: Russian forces conducted extensive multi-region strikes during September 2026 targeting Kyiv, Odessa, Sumy, and Belgorod with ballistic missiles and drones. Significant infrastructure damage occurred in Belgorod and Kyiv, including power grid failures and urban fires. These operations represent intensified offensive pressure alongside ongoing defensive engagements.
key_points: Russian forces executed ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv using more than twenty missiles, causing widespread fires in the Obolonsky district and multiple explosions throughout the city center

Major Odessa strikes resulted in multiple fires and explosions across various neighborhoods, demonstrating sustained aerial and ground campaign intensity in the southern region with significant civilian impact
